propositions: /rerun and recheck-review acceptance paths enqueue a forced event only to the process-local asyncio queue, causing the request to disappear if the receiver exits before processing, leaving stale Gerrit votes and SQLite dedup rows that block reconciliation.
Reconciliation checks local voted state before querying Gerrit, causing it to skip revisions whose stale local rows survive after their Gerrit votes are reset.

The approved repair requires accepted requests to first write exactly LLM-Review: 0 to the exact revision, generating a durable Gerrit comment-added event with patchSet.revision and patchSet.ref before acknowledging or resetting the retry budget.
Reconciliation must query Gerrit first and clear only the exact matching stale dedup row upon finding no nonzero vote, while preserving dedup and holding the cursor on Gerrit read errors.

The fixed-neutral reset operation with value exactly 0 is privileged and cannot be influenced by contributor text or comment content, preserving the label-free reply invariant for PASS/BLOCK decisions.
